items.topic: fragments.md lists a nonexistent Primitive type
items.claim: skills/judo-model-mermaid/references/fragments.md: primitive types live in Sandbox::types (String, Integer, ...): list them with `query esm Primitive --select name`
items.fact: `query esm Primitive` fails with "esm type 'Primitive' does not exist". Primitives are in Sandbox::types (String, Timestamp, Text, Integer, Boolean, Phone...). List them one type family per query: `query esm StringType --select fqn`, then NumericType, BooleanType, DateType etc. The CLI does not accept comma-separated type names (`query esm NumericType,DataMember` fails). An attribute's dataType takes a Primitive or enumeration reference. Fixed in commit 5256a5a.

items.topic: Audit interceptor does not cover custom operations
items.claim: Old blueprint text implied an audit interceptor covers everything.
items.fact: Per judo-doc-problems.md, interceptors run only on built-in operations, so custom operations must write their own audit rows; the interceptor is a variation for built-in operations only. UserDao, VariableResolver and the audit service are project code, not platform API.

items.topic: Never edit models directly; parallel work in worktrees merged with CLI merge
items.claim: Agent plan ran 25 parallel agents that could touch shared model files.
items.fact: Operator: "models should never be edited directly ... different worktree and model can be merged using the ci [cli]!" Rule: one writer per model file; parallel model work uses separate worktrees/copies from the same base, joined with CLI `merge`.

Rule 4: a model file is changed by exactly one CLI session at a time; never point two agents, two terminals or CLI + Designer at the same .model (each holds an in-memory copy; last save silently overwrites). Rule 5: each parallel task gets its own worktree/copy from the same commit; join with `merge <theirs.model> --base <base.model>`: --dry-run first, then validate --strict, save, status, commit; merge never runs git. Stop CLI server when done with a copy. Committed 37575d6; also added to skills/judo-model-mermaid/references/fragments.md and target/passb/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

items.claim: No documentation of the judo CLI merge command behaviour.
items.fact: `judo-cli.jar -m a.model merge <b.model> --base <base.model> [--dry-run] [--take=<key>,...] [--theirs-aird=<file>]`. With --base from a common base, two copies adding different packages/entities merged with 0 conflicts (13 changes), validate --strict passed, save gave state clean. Without --base the CLI cannot see the shared parent package and reports an add-add conflict (e.g. 'conflict 1 add-add Sandbox::bp name', with key add:<id>, and fix hints: keep mine / take theirs with --take add:<id>); it also creates Sandbox::bp_theirs. Output prints a '[WARN] Zeta transformation not yet implemented, falling back to ETL' that is harmless.

items.claim: CLI command list in docs may be incomplete.
items.fact: CLI help lists: query, graphql, create, update, delete, move (reorder within parent), relocate (change parent, keeps identity and inbound references), fill (create/populate a transfer object's view/form/table from its members), split (split a container into two Groups), status, merge, import.

items.topic: CLI JVMs/servers accumulate; cap heap and stop servers
items.fact: The CLI keeps one server session per model file; 28 stray judo-cli JVMs remained after aborted agents. Use JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-Xmx512m -XX:+UseSerialGC", run each scratch Sandbox in its own dir, run `server stop` afterwards, and `pkill -f judo-cli.jar` to clean up. Never run many in parallel (memory).

items.topic: Subagent fan-out of 25 at once aborts; use background pi -p workers
items.claim: Launching 25 (or 6) Agent subagents in one parallel block
items.fact: Foreground Agent calls got 'Subagent aborted by parent' (25 and then 6 parallel), with one 'produced no final output'; they left half-edited files that had to be git-checkout reverted. Operator asked: "can't you launch them as background subagents?" Agent responded with target/passb/run.py, a background runner doing N parallel `pi -p` workers (nohup, per-batch logs/status, skip done). Operator earlier set parallel limit of 6.

items.topic: Pilot one subagent before fan-out; shared INSTRUCTIONS.md
items.fact: Pass B rewrite of catalog entries to the new kb format: pilot one @fast judo-blueprint-author subagent on audit-log-entity, fold its problems into target/passb/INSTRUCTIONS.md, then batch (103 blueprints in 13 batches, 71 model/74 backend/62 frontend practices in 5/4/3). Lint: entry-lint; check: `check <id>` (validate --strict, diagram equals render, no leaked classes). Fragments at fragments/<id>.model; backend/frontend practices need no fragment.

items.topic: model-development.md ESM file doc says never edit as text, but judo-cli rule ordering
items.claim: Existing text: ESM model file is XMI; change only via CLI or Designer.
